text:
All panelists agree on the figures. The scheduled end-to-end travel time between Orrinford Junction and Tarnside Park is 23 minutes, and trains will run every 6 minutes at peak.

Answer: 23 minutes end-to-end; every 6 minutes at peak.

All panelists agree that dredging will deepen the berth pocket from 14.5 metres to 17.8 metres, and the terminal's planned annual capacity after expansion will be 2.1 million TEU.

Answer: The berth pocket will be deepened to 17.8 metres, and the terminal's annual capacity after expansion will be 2.1 million TEU.

The three-phase expansion programme lays 12.4 km (Phase 1), 8.7 km (Phase 2), and 15.6 km (Phase 3) of new pipe, totalling 36.7 km. The existing 184 km network is excluded as it is not new pipe.

Answer: 36.7 kilometres

All panelists agree that the original public opening of 14 September 2026, plus the announced 11-week (77-day) delay, results in a new expected opening date of 30 November 2026.

Answer: 30 November 2026

All panelists unanimously agree that mean systolic blood pressure fell by 13.6 mmHg in the tirnapexil arm at week 16, and 19 tirnapexil participants experienced hyperkalaemia.

Answer: Mean systolic blood pressure fell by 13.6 mmHg; 19 tirnapexil participants had hyperkalaemia.

All panelists agree that in the placebo group, FVC declined by 171 mL over 52 weeks. The most common adverse event was diarrhoea, reported in 22% of olvemarin participants.

Answer: FVC declined by 171 mL over 52 weeks in the placebo group; the most common adverse event was diarrhoea.

In the senotrazide arm, 54 of 450 participants discontinued the study drug before day 3, yielding a discontinuation rate of 12%.

Answer: 12%

Of the 312 participants randomized to the pelvastrin arm, 27 withdrew consent, 14 were lost to follow-up, and 19 died before month 24, totaling 60 non-completers. All remaining participants completed the 24-month follow-up.

Answer: 252

Corvane Logistics' year-end order backlog was $386 million, and the company guided fiscal-2026 revenue growth of 6% to 8%.

Answer: $386 million backlog; 6%–8% revenue growth guidance for fiscal 2026.

All panelists unanimously agree on the figures supported by the evidence packet. Ostrel Savings Bank's CET1 ratio at year end was 14.3% (E2), and its net interest margin for 2025 was 2.17% (E3).

Answer: CET1 ratio 14.3%; net interest margin 2.17%.

Brightfen Foods' net sales increased from $250 million in fiscal 2024 to $295 million in fiscal 2025, a rise of $45 million. Dividing by the fiscal-2024 base gives 18% growth.

Answer: 18%

Tamberlin Software defines free cash flow as operating cash flow minus capital expenditures. For fiscal 2025, operating cash flow was $87.3 million and capital expenditures were $52.9 million, yielding $34.4 million.

Answer: $34.4 million

All panelists unanimously agree that the jury awarded $1.64 million in compensatory damages and declined to award punitive damages.

Answer: The jury awarded $1.64 million in compensatory damages and did not award punitive damages.

The contractual cap on Solgrave's total liability was 7.5 million euros, and the tribunal awarded Ventrica 6.9 million euros.

Answer: The contractual cap was €7.5 million; the tribunal awarded Ventrica €6.9 million.

All panelists agree: the effective date is 18 February 2025 (E2), and payment is due 45 calendar days later with 19 February as day 1 (E3). Counting through February (10 days), March (31 days), and into April, day 45 falls on 4 April 2025.

Answer: 4 April 2025

The defendant was ordered to pay $2.35 million in compensatory damages (already reduced 20% for contributory negligence), $0.41 million in prejudgment interest, and $0.12 million in taxable court costs. Legal fees are not recoverable.

Answer: $2.88 million

The tephra layer was dated to 4,270 years before present and found at a depth of 3.8 metres in the sediment core (E4).

Answer: 4,270 years before present, at a depth of 3.8 metres.

All panelists unanimously agree on the figures. LXP-9 exhibited a room-temperature ionic conductivity of 0.84 mS/cm, and test cells retained 88% of their initial capacity after 500 cycles.

Answer: 0.84 mS/cm ionic conductivity; 88% capacity retention after 500 cycles.

The terminus retreated 384 metres between the 2008 and 2024 surveys, a span of 16 years. Dividing 384 by 16 gives an average retreat rate of 24 metres per year.

Answer: 24 metres per year

The 2015 census recorded 1,480 breeding pairs and the 2025 census recorded 1,110, a decline of 370 pairs. Dividing by the 2015 baseline (370 ÷ 1,480) gives a 25% decline.

Answer: 25%

All panelists unanimously agree on the figures. The records of 48,600 patients were exposed, and the attacker first gained access on 29 July 2025. The 12 August 2025 date refers to when the intrusion was detected, not when access was first obtained.

Answer: 48,600 patients' records were exposed; the attacker first gained access on 29 July 2025.

All panelists agree that an estimated 340 kilograms of ammonia was released before the refrigeration line was isolated, and 3 workers were admitted to hospital overnight out of 17 evaluated.

Answer: 340 kilograms of ammonia were released, and 3 workers were admitted to hospital overnight.

The outage lasted 4 hours and 25 minutes, from the first errors at 22:47 UTC on 9 October to the recorded end at 03:12 UTC on 10 October.

Answer: 4 hours and 25 minutes

The panel unanimously calculated that during the 35-minute incident, checkout attempts averaged 1,200 per minute (42,000 total), with a 30% failure rate, yielding 12,600 failed attempts.

Answer: 12,600 checkout attempts failed during the incident.
